# hpe_morpheus_container_script (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Library Container Script resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_container_script" "example" {
  name          = "Install Dependencies"
  script_phase  = "provision"
  script_type   = "bash"
  script        = file("/path-to-file")
  sudo_user     = true
  fail_on_error = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the library container script.

### Optional

- `category` (String) The category of the library container script.
- `fail_on_error` (Boolean) Whether the script fails on error.
- `labels` (List of String) The labels of the library container script.
- `run_as_user` (String) The user to run the script as.
- `script` (String) The script content.
- `script_phase` (String) The phase of the script.
- `script_type` (String) The type of the script.
- `script_version` (String) The version of the script.
- `sudo_user` (Boolean) Whether to run the script as sudo.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the library container script.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_container_script.example 123
```
